user.title: Choose your ILIFE app
user.description: Pick the app your vacuum is set up with.

ilifehome.description: Sign in with your ILIFE / whitelabel (e.g. AVA, ZACO) account. Pick your brand and the region your account was created in.

ilife_clean.description: ILIFE Clean vacuums (e.g. the T20s) run on Tuya's cloud. Create a free Tuya IoT Cloud Project at iot.tuya.com (development method "Smart Home"), then link your vacuum's account to it under Devices → Link App Account. Note: the linking QR code must be scanned from the Tuya Smart / Smart Life app — the ILIFE Clean app has no account-authorization scanner, so the vacuum has to be re-paired in Tuya Smart first (see the README). Then enter the project's Access ID, Access Secret and the linked account's UID here, picking the data center the project was created in.

reauth_confirm_tuya.description: Re-enter the Tuya Cloud Project Access ID and Access Secret.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials — see Settings → System → Logs for the exact reason reported by the server
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect — see Settings → System → Logs for details
error.no_devices: Connected, but this UID owns no devices. Check the UID is the one shown under Devices → Link App Account in your Tuya Cloud Project, and that the vacuum is paired to that account.

device_offline.message: The vacuum is asleep at its dock and can't be reached from the cloud right now. It wakes automatically for scheduled cleans; on-demand commands only work while it is awake.

command_unsupported.message: {device} does not advertise a data point for "{action}", so there is no command to send it. If the official app can do this, please open an issue with the integration's diagnostics attached.

fan_speed_unsupported.message: "{fan_speed}" is not a suction level this vacuum accepts. Supported: {options}.

room_unknown.message: "{room}" is not a room on this vacuum's map. Known rooms: {rooms}.

ilife_clean_only.message: "{action}" is only available on ILIFE Clean (Tuya) vacuums; ILIFEHOME has no equivalent command.

local_refused.message: The vacuum refused the command over the local network, so it was not carried out.

local_unconfirmed.message: The vacuum did not confirm the command over the local network. It has most likely carried it out: check it before sending it again.

voice_not_shuffled.message: The chosen voice has nothing to shuffle: pick a pack whose pack.json says "shuffle": true.

shuffle_voice.name: Shuffle the voice after each clean

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Cleans only the given rooms (ILIFE Clean laser models).

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names as in the app, or room numbers (the vacuum's 'rooms' attribute lists both).

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: 1, or 2 to add a second, crosswise pass.

clean_zone.name: Clean zone
clean_zone.description: Cleans the given rectangles (ILIFE Clean laser models; the map camera's calibration_points convert image pixels to these coordinates).

zone.name: Zones
zone.description: Up to 5 rectangles [x1, y1, x2, y2] in map cells from the map origin, y up (5 cm cells on the A30 Pro).

repeats.name: Passes
repeats.description: 1, or 2 to clean each zone twice.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Creates a cleaning schedule, or changes the given fields of an existing one (ILIFE Clean laser models).

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Schedule 1-7 to change; leave empty to create a new one.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms to clean (names as in the app, or numbers); an empty list cleans the whole home.

init.title: Local control
init.description: ILIFE Clean can talk to the vacuum directly over your network (faster, works without the cloud). The cloud stays as a fallback.

data.host: Vacuum IP address (leave empty to find it automatically)

abort.no_options: This account type has no options.
